actions.description: Start temperature control and the pump (out_mode_05 1) at the stored set point
actions.name: start_circulation

outputs.description: True once in_mode_05 confirms that temperature control is started
outputs.name: running

actions.description: Stop temperature control and the pump (out_mode_05 0), the native stop and safe state
actions.name: stop_circulation

outputs.description: False once in_mode_05 confirms that temperature control is stopped
outputs.name: running

adjusts.description: Working temperature set point, written with two decimals (out_sp_00)
adjusts.name: setpoint

device.model: CORIO CD/CP, MAGIO MS, DYNEO DD circulator
device.name: JULABO heating or refrigerated circulator (labmcp-julabo)

facts.text: bath_temperature_c reads in_pv_00, heating_power_pct reads in_pv_01, safety_sensor_temperature_c reads in_pv_03 and excess_temperature_protection_c reads in_pv_04
setpoint_c reads in_sp_00 and set_setpoint writes out_sp_00 with two decimals and reads it back
is_running reads in_mode_05; start writes out_mode_05 1 and verifies is_running
The upstream start_circulation tool reads the current set point and checks it against its operator safety limits before starting, because the set point may have been changed on the front panel
stop writes out_mode_05 0, retries once and returns True only if in_mode_05 confirms the stop
require_remote refuses settings when status has kind state and remote is False
Status codes 0 to 3 are manual stop, manual start, remote stop and remote start
parse_status classifies known command-error codes as command_error and other negative codes as alarm
A set point outside the temperature limits set on the circulator is rejected with -13
RS-232 factory settings are 4800 baud, 7 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit and RTS/CTS handshake
CORIO CD has only in_pv_00/01/03/04, in_sp_00, in_mode_05, out_sp_00, out_mode_05, version and status; the external Pt100 sensor in_pv_02 needs MAGIO or DYNEO
The README describes stop_circulation as stopping temperature control and the pump, then confirming with in_mode_05
The MCP server's set point safety limits default to 5 and 90 Cel and the README tells the operator to set them to the bath fluid's working range

operator_required.name: setpoint
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states the working temperature range of the circulator; the server's 5 to 90 Cel defaults are operator-configurable water-bath limits (README.md:79-83), not a device bound, so the operator supplies the range of the installed unit and bath fluid

safe_state.description: temperature control and pump stopped (out_mode_05 0); the bath and its fluid stay hot or cold and are not physically isolated
